title: feat(studio): configurable property panels for page-editor blocks
body:
Adds typed, protocol-aligned property panels to the Studio page block inspector for the minimal SDUI-essential blocks (element:text, element:image, page:header, page:card, record:related_list), editing the block's properties instead of only generic type/id/className/hidden. Driven by a block-config schema. Browser-verified (read + edit round-trip) + unit tests. Follow-up: prune shell-chrome blocks from the palette, expand config coverage.
